tasks.label: NixOS: Rebuild (test)
tasks.command: set HOSTNAME (hostname | sed 's/nixos-//'); and sudo nixos-rebuild test --flake .#$HOSTNAME

tasks.label: NixOS: Rebuild (test with auto-revert)
tasks.command: set HOSTNAME (hostname | sed 's/nixos-//'); and echo 'Building and testing - will AUTO-REVERT in 30 seconds...'; and sudo nixos-rebuild test --flake .#$HOSTNAME; and echo ''; and echo 'Config applied! Auto-reverting in 30 seconds...'; and sleep 30; and echo 'Reverting now...'; and sudo nixos-rebuild switch --rollback; and echo 'Reverted to previous config.'

tasks.label: NixOS: Rebuild and Switch
tasks.command: set HOSTNAME (hostname | sed 's/nixos-//'); and sudo nixos-rebuild switch --flake .#$HOSTNAME
